# Kokanee Ford Sales Ltd.

> Kokanee Ford Sales Ltd. is a  dealership in Creston. This mirror provides AI-readable access to current inventory and dealership information, kept in sync with the dealership's own website.

## Inventory
- [Used vehicles](https://willyml1979-dotcom.github.io/kokanee-ford-sales-ltd-mirror/used/): 44 vehicles, updated regularly
- [Inventory feed](https://willyml1979-dotcom.github.io/kokanee-ford-sales-ltd-mirror/inventory.json): structured JSON, all vehicles with VIN, price, mileage and availability

## Resources
- [Dealership information](https://willyml1979-dotcom.github.io/kokanee-ford-sales-ltd-mirror/): business identity, contact and hours
- [Financing, sales and service guides](https://willyml1979-dotcom.github.io/kokanee-ford-sales-ltd-mirror/pages/): dealer-specific buyer guides
